method: Photon transport by Monte Carlo (16M histories, two Co-60 lines, uniform-in-solid-angle 10x10 cm2 source at 100 cm SSD) with Compton (Klein-Nishina), Rayleigh (approximate Thomson shape), photoelectric and pair processes. Fluences were scored by track length in the 1 cm radius, 0.2 cm thick cylinder; primary fluence analytic as 0.5*exp(-mu*5) per line. Interaction and energy-transfer fractions use XCOM cross sections. Electrons: Klein-Nishina sampling of Compton electrons; slowing-down fluence with Moller delta rays above 10 keV and ESTAR stopping powers and radiation yields. Dose: kerma profile convolved with an exponential electron kernel (mean displacement about 0.096 cm) to obtain D(z), dmax and PDD. Spencer-Attix ratio uses Bethe scaling of water stopping powers to air. Approximate (not fully tallied) items: L3 spectra and direction, L4 spectrum and radiative ratio, scattered angular histogram, and the Rayleigh angular shape. Bremsstrahlung and fluorescence photons are neglected.
data_sources: XCOM-based water coefficients (/tmp/data/xcom_water.txt: coherent, incoherent, photoelectric, pair, totals) and ESTAR water stopping powers, CSDA ranges and radiation yields (/tmp/data/estar_water.txt). Air stopping powers for the Spencer-Attix ratio were not supplied; they were obtained by Bethe scaling (Z/A and I = 85.7 eV for air, I = 75 eV for water). Delta-ray cross sections from the Moller formula with the standard 2*pi*r_e^2*m_e c^2*n_e/beta^2 normalisation.
